title: If the parts are produced, the universe itself is produced
source_text: XXI. Jam autem si corpora, quibus hoc universum constat, entia producta sunt, & quae sui causam & originem habent, ipsum quoque universum productum esse necesse est. Nam quod constat partibus productis improductum esse non potest.
pass_a_gloss: But now if the bodies of which this universe consists are produced beings, and have a cause and origin of themselves, the universe itself also must be produced. For what consists of produced parts cannot be unproduced.
pass_b_english: A whole of produced parts cannot itself be unproduced.

choices.term: quod constat partibus productis improductum esse non potest
choices.english: what consists of produced parts cannot be unproduced
choices.why: Whole inherits produced status from parts.
rejected: the universe can be a-se while parts are not
